name: Shared visits persist across browsers
description: Each separate page visit increases a shared persistent total while refreshing the displayed total does not add a visit.
steps: Actor A opens the page and waits for a numeric counter; record the total.
Actor B opens the same page in a separate browser context and waits for a numeric counter.
Actor A clicks Refresh total and compares the result with Actor B.
Actor A clicks Refresh total again without reloading the page.
expected: Hello ChatGPT is visible. Actor B sees at least one more visit than the initial Actor A total. Actor A sees the same shared total after refreshing it. Refresh total itself does not increment the count absent other visitors.

name: Mobile visits survive reload
description: A mobile page reload records another visit and retains the existing shared total.
steps: Open the page on mobile and wait for the numeric count; record it.
Reload the page and wait for the numeric count.
expected: The count after reload is at least one greater than before. Refresh total preserves the total absent other visitors. The heading, counter, refresh button, and explanation that refreshes count as visits fit without horizontal scrolling.

name: Failed visit offers retry
description: A failed visit request shows a clear error and an available retry control.
steps: Open the page with the visit API fault active.
Read the counter status and press Try again.
expected: The page displays Could not connect to the counter and a Try again button. It does not fabricate a numeric total. With the fault still active, retry retains the visible error and re-enables the button.
